exposure: Women with a prior vaginal delivery
trial of labor after one previous cesarean delivery (TOLAC1)
Trial of labor after two cesarean deliveries (TOLAC2)
trial of labor after two cesarean deliveries (TOLAC2)
Women with no previous vaginal deliveries
outcome: Combined adverse outcome (uterine rupture, postpartum hemorrhage, 5-minute Apgar score < 7, pH < 7.1)
cohort: 381 women who underwent TOLAC2 compared to 3,635 women who underwent trial of labor after one previous cesarean delivery (TOLAC1)
finding: Women attempting TOLAC2 had a lower chance of vaginal birth after cesarean delivery (VBAC) and a higher risk of uterine rupture but not combined adverse outcomes compared to women attempting TOLAC1.
mod_finding: Women attempting a trial of labor after two cesarean deliveries (TOLAC2) were less likely to achieve vaginal births after cesarean delivery (VBAC) compared to those attempting a trial of labor after one previous cesarean delivery (TOLAC1).
